error_model.logging: Does not log; relies on Cleanable checks.
raises: ValueError for missing spell, spell_id, node, or node_id
RuntimeError if the research line has been cleaned
KeyError for unknown mutation node ids

side_effects: Stores weak reference to a live spell blueprint
Mutates mutation node graph and HEAD pointer

runtime_couplings: Stores SpellMutationNode structures produced by callers.
Uses SyncWeakRef to track the live spell blueprint.

dependents.notes: Mutation line for a specific spell blueprint version.

integration_flow: Create ResearchSpell for a spell version
Begin and commit mutation nodes as the blueprint evolves

usage_snippets.title: Commit a spell mutation
usage_snippets.code:
line = ResearchSpell(spell_id='sha256')
node = line.begin_mutation(message='tweak', tags=['exp'])
line.commit_mutation(node)

order_constraints: Cleanup nodes before dropping weak references

lifecycle.construction: Initializes node graph, metadata, and weak-ref slot for the live spell.
lifecycle.ownership: Owns mutation node graph, commit-order list, and metadata.

invariants: head_id tracks the most recently committed node.
node_ids preserves commit order for list_nodes.
Mutation graph mutations are guarded by the lock.
non_goals: Does not implement structure capture or apply logic.
pitfalls: Committing nodes without a populated structure.
responsibilities: Track mutation nodes for a spell blueprint version.
Expose attachment to a live spell via weak ref.

summary.detail: Tracks a mutation graph for a spell blueprint version, storing mutation nodes, HEAD, and a weak reference to the runtime spell.
summary.one_liner: Tracks mutation history for a spell blueprint version.
